children: When should a product start a post-launch analytics engagement?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-ff19cf5 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Right after launch. The first 30 days generate the clearest behavioral signals your product will ever produce, so starting early costs far less than catching up later.
What metrics does the post-launch audit cover?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-ab2c7ed e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Day-one, day-seven, and day-30 retention rates, funnel completion, error frequency, session depth, feature adoption, and acquisition-to-activation conversion. Additional metrics get added based on your product category.
How long does a post-launch engagement typically run?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-98f1802 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: At least three months. You need two full test-and-measure cycles to get reliable directional signals, and compounding improvements take sustained work to build.
Do you work with products built by other development teams?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-4b43fec e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: All the time. The audit works across any codebase or tech stack. A short onboarding session at the start gets the team fully up to speed.
What is the difference between post-launch iteration and ongoing maintenance?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-ad64974 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Maintenance keeps things stable. Iteration moves your performance metrics forward. They serve different purposes, and the studio handles both within the same engagement when needed.
What does your A/B testing process involve?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-f5dd21c e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Each experiment runs with a single variable, a defined hypothesis, a calculated sample size, and a significance threshold that must be hit before any result counts.
Can the team help reprioritize a product roadmap based on post-launch data?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-9a206fb e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Absolutely. The initial roadmap almost always shifts after real users arrive. The audit surfaces which planned items still hold up and which assumptions the data has already contradicted.
Do you conduct user research as part of the engagement?

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-490096b e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child

children: Yes. In-app surveys, user interviews, and support ticket analysis run alongside behavioral data throughout, adding the interpretive context that analytics alone cannot provide. The
role of UI/UX design in mobile app success
becomes especially clear when qualitative feedback is compared with observed behavior.

props.className: migrated-element migrated-element-0b86545 e-con-full e-flex e-con e-child
